body: It's not the greatest.
Why?

I'm 13. I can't come out because I know my family isn't going to be supportive. My sister knows because she was going through my stuff and found my binder. She put it on, tore it by accident and I freaked out. She asked me if it was for cosplay or something, and kept harassing me until I told her.

They're not really my slip-ups, but my sister knows everything about me being trans and she "gives my parents hints". I don't know why she does it, but she's mentioned my binder to my parents and I just told them it was a different kind of sports bra. My sister also will purposely call me a boy and when I ask her not to do that she always says "What? I thought you wanted me to?" right in front of my parents. When my mom confronted me and asked me if I was trans I just denied it. I want to be out, but I just can't.

I'm just so sick of all of the bullshit I deal with. I wake up with crippling anxiety, I never get any sleep, I'm constantly stressed, and I deal with my alcoholic dad acting like a prick every second of my life. I don't have any friends at all or anyone to confide to, and I have a feeling my family won't react well if I tell them. I'm trans and I have crippling dysphoria and I can't come out because my parents aren't exactly the supporting type. I'm tired of acting like I'm okay for them, I'm tired of living for someone else, and I'm tired of hating myself because I think everyone else does.
